content:
sam_sales: Hey team — CoralHealth is greenlit for a 4-week POC. They need a compliance bundle before legal signs the SOW: SOC 2 Type II report (redacted ok), ISO 27001 certificate excerpt, a signed pen-test attestation/letter, and a network diagram showing staging topology. Also asking for Dedicated vs Hosted delta for baseline 100 rps and burst profiles.
anya_security: Copy. I can assemble the SOC2/ISO excerpts and the control matrix. ETA 48h. Will we host artifacts in our secure evidence bucket or send a zip? :lock:
sam_sales: Pref for a zip uploaded to their SFTP, but Coral wants evidence cataloged with an index and short descriptions for each artifact. Can we give presigned links for sensitive files?
devin_se: We can generate presigned S3 links. Default expiry is 7 days — can set to 72h if they want. Example:```aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/coral-poc/soc2.pdf --expires-in 259200```
lee_support: Heads up: for Dedicated pricing delta I need the expected peak concurrency and target p99 latency SLO. Pricing team uses those to model GPU tier. Sam, any numbers from Coral?
sam_sales: Coral CTO said baseline 100 rps, spikes to 450 rps for 2min bursts, target p99 <= 400ms. They're okay with a short performance run during POC.
anya_security: For the pen-test attestation: legal needs a signed letter stating we conducted a pen-test within last 12 months and summarizing severity posture (no PII exposures). We can provide the vendor name + scan date + high-level finding summary (no raw vuln reports). Kate, can legal sign a standard attestation?
kate_legal: Yes — I have a template. I need confirmation we can share vendor + date only and not raw exploit details. I can draft, sign, and return in 24h once security approves phrasing.
anya_security: Confirm we only share meta (vendor, date, scope, statement that external pentest was performed; no exploit details). I'll prep the wording.
coral_cto: FYI, we need SSO for the staging env and a short runbook for access. Also need SAML metadata or OIDC client info.
devin_se: For SSO we support SAML and OIDC. For POC easiest path is temporary SAML SP metadata we provide — need Coral's IdP metadata and a test account. We can also do ephemeral tokens.
sam_sales: I'll ask for their IdP metadata. Also Coral asked whether Dedicated requires network peering or can be done over public endpoints with IP allowlist.
lee_support: Dedicated usually needs a private peering for low latency, but we can do single-tenant Dedicated over public endpoints with strict IP allowlist + TLS if they accept slightly higher network jitter. That changes pricing (adds NAT/egress) — estimate +15-25% on top of base monthly commit. Will confirm with finance.
kate_legal: Drafting pen-test attestation now. Want a quick checklist from security: vendor name, date, scope statement, and approved sentence about non-disclosure of raw reports. Any additional items?
anya_security: Add statement of remediation policy window (e.g., criticals tracked and remediated within 30 days) — generic, no specifics. I'll drop a short checklist doc to the evidence bucket.
devin_se: I'll attach the staging network diagram and sample SAML metadata snippet to the evidence bundle. Diagram will show load balancer, dedicated pool, and optional peer.
docs-bot: Uploaded: /evidence/coralhealth/poc/readme.md (internal link) — contains artifact index, checklist, and presign instructions.
sam_sales: Great. Action items: @anya_security assemble SOC2+ISO excerpts + checklist (48h), @kate_legal produce signed pen-test attestation (24h after security phrasing), @devin_se produce staging diagram + SAML example (48h), @lee_support confirm Dedicated pricing delta with finance (EOD tomorrow). I'll ping Coral for IdP metadata and confirm SFTP for zip or presigned links.
coral_cto: Thanks all. If possible please include an expected timeline for Dedicated provisioning and a short runbook for failover to Hosted if provisioning slips.
lee_support: Will add provisioning timeline: Dedicated baseline provisioning ~10 business days after PO + network approvals; expedited 5 days possible with express fees. Also include fallback steps.
sam_sales: Perfect. I'll update Coral and close loop. :thumbsup:
